_: The expected answer of the triage stage for photographs that are NOT parking signs. They have no reading reference and cannot have one: there is nothing to read. The file is needed to tell "the reference is not written yet" from "there will be no reference", and so that the measurement can count the share of false passes — before these photographs, triage answered `parking_sign` forty times out of forty, and its ability to refuse had never once been measured.
